name: beach_buggy
notes: An older open-tub beach buggy on the sand rail's chassis, tuned to be quick and planted: long soft travel with valved dampers to swallow voxel steps, a high ride, all-wheel drive so the throttle doesn't spin it, and assists that keep it level and off its side. A handbrake flick starts a drift that holding the view down the road keeps.
title: BEACH BUGGY
